Location2: PRIVATE RESIDENCE

Medium Affected: AIR
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.411078, -83.195641 (Approximated from premise)
Report Description///THIS IS A 48 HOUR PHMSA UPDATE TO INCIDENT REPORT NUMBER 1380711./// UPDATED INFORMATION: CALLER STATED IT WAS DETERMINED THERE WAS NO RELEASE FROM THE OPERATOR PIPELINE. THE CUSTOMERS PIPELINE WAS OPEN AT THE WATER HEATER. THE WATER HEATER WAS DISCOVERED DISCONNECT AT THE FUEL LINE. PREVIOUS INCIDENT DESCRIPTION: CALLER STATED THEY RECEIVED A CALL FROM THE DETROIT FIRE DEPARTMENT REGARDING A HOME EXPLOSION AND FIRE. CALLER STATED A PRIVATE RESIDENCE AT 16251 SUSSEX STREET, DETROIT HAD AN EXPLOSION. UPON ARRIVAL THE HOUSE APPEARED TO HAVE EXPLODED ALL OVER THE STREET. ANOTHER PRIVATE RESIDENCE NEXT TO THIS HOME (16241 SUSSEX ST) ALSO EXPERIENCED SEVER DAMAGE AS WELL. THE CAUSE OF THE EXPLOSION WAS DUE TO A NATURAL GAS BUILD UP IN THE HOUSE AT 16251 SUSSEX STREET . THERE WAS ONE REPORTED INJURY. THE FIRE WAS EXTINGUISHED. THE INTERSECTION OF SUSSEX ST AND FLORENCE ST WERE CLOSED DUE TO THE INCIDENT. INVESTIGATION IS CURRENTLY UNDERWAY.

IT MEASURED 5.54 NM IN LENGTH AND 0.10 NM AT ITS MAXIMUM WIDTH. AT THE TIME THE IMAGE WAS CAPTURED, WINDS WERE COMING FROM THE SOUTH AT 11 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: A POINT SOURCE COULD NOT BE IDENTIFIED, AND THE ANOMALY WAS NOT IMMEDIATELY CO LOCATED WITH ANY OIL FACILITIES OR WELLS.
